SELECT CAST(ROUND(
  COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(o.items_ex_vat)
    FROM orders o
    WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND o.paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.paid_at < '2026-04-01'
  ), 0)
  -
  COALESCE((
    SELECT SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN r.refund_type = 'FULL' THEN o.items_ex_vat
        ELSE r.refund_amount / 1.1
      END
    )
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND o.paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
      AND o.paid_at < '2026-04-01'
  ), 0)
) AS net_revenue;
